point: `remex search INDEX QUERY_FILE` takes a file of comma-separated query vectors and prints one JSON line per query with its nearest ids and scores. You can tune the results with `-k` and `--bits`, which trade recall against speed, and rescoring happens only if the index was built with `--keep-float`.
